head_coach.name: Mauricio Pochettino
head_coach.play_style_summary: An aggressive, high-pressing, and vertically direct attacking style that emphasizes tactical flexibility. The system transitions fluidly from a 4-2-3-1 base into a 3-2-5 in possession or a compact 4-4-2 pressing structure off the ball. It relies on intense off-ball runs from midfielders, fast transitions after winning possession, and dynamic full-back movement to exploit wide channels.

key_players.name: Christian Pulisic
key_players.performance_stats: Played 34 games for AC Milan across all competitions in the 2025/2026 club season [2.1.6]. He averaged 1.4 shots per game, completed 79% of his passes, and maintained an average FotMob rating of 7.11 as a primary creative engine on the flank.

key_players.name: Folarin Balogun
key_players.performance_stats: Appeared in 29 matches in Ligue 1 for AS Monaco during the 2025/2026 season. He registered 60 shots, averaged 2.0 shots per game, and recorded a 7.03 average FotMob rating as a key attacking spearhead.

key_players.name: Weston McKennie
key_players.performance_stats: Maintained an 89% pass completion rate, a 7.22 average FotMob rating in Serie A, and played 48 matches across all competitions for Juventus, anchoring the midfield with elite work rate and defensive recoveries.
